## The Accounting Capacity Challenge

Busy season hits every year, but permanent staff can't handle the 2-3x workload spike. You're forced to turn away clients or burn out your team.

Big 4 and regional firms charge premium rates for temporary staff. You're paying $150+/hour for work that should cost half that.

Finding CPAs who can hit the ground running is difficult. You need professionals who understand your engagement types and can work independently.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Active CPA licenses verified directly with state boards
- Experience across audit, tax, and advisory services
- Familiar with major accounting software: CCH, Thomson Reuters, CaseWare
- Public accounting and corporate accounting backgrounds available
- Fast ramp for busy season, year-end close, and special projects
